description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class 'PurgeStrategyTest' that tests the functionalities of the 'PurgeStrategy' class within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup for mock objects, several test methods verifying service retrieval, match criteria, record fetching, parameter access, and class name determination related to purge strategies. The test interacts with the EntityManager, utilizes dependency injection, and references external classes and services related to the maintenance purge process.

classes.name: PurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests various methods of the 'PurgeStrategy' class related to entity purging logic in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a mock of the 'PurgeStrategy' class with specific configuration parameters and populates test data from fixture files.

methods.name: testGetPurgeEmployeeService
methods.description: Verifies that the 'getPurgeService' method returns an instance of 'PurgeService'.

methods.name: testGetMatchByValues
methods.description: Checks that 'getMatchByValues' returns correct matching criteria array for a given ID.

methods.name: testGetPurgeRecords
methods.description: Ensures 'getEntityRecords' retrieves the expected Employee record based on match criteria.

methods.name: testGetParameters
methods.description: Validates that 'getParameters' returns the correct configuration array for purge string parameters.

methods.name: testGetEntityClassName
methods.description: Confirms that 'getEntityClassName' returns the class name 'Employee'.

methods.name: testGetEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Checks that 'getEntityFieldMap' returns the expected match and join fields.
